modules.title: 一次手机导航修复在什么情况下继续、暂停或结束
应用怎样决定下一轮是否继续

items.title: 检查失败时继续
items.text: 如果失败是第一次出现，而且还没达到尝试上限，应用把检查结果交给下一轮继续处理。

items.title: 达到上限或需要确认时暂停
items.text: 同类失败连续出现两次，或下一步要修改共享样式时，应用停下来保留证据并请求确认。

items.title: 真实检查通过后结束
items.text: 只有构建通过且 390px 页面不再横向滚动，任务才结束；AI 说“完成”不算检查结果。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: ReAct 关注“新证据怎样改变下一步行动”；Agent 循环关注“应用是否再运行一轮”，包括次数、权限、暂停和结束条件。

lessonPractice.title: Agent 修复手机导航后，同一项横向滚动检查连续失败两次。规则规定同类失败最多两次，接下来应该怎样做？

options.label: 暂停任务，保留两轮检查结果，并在扩大修改范围前请求确认
options.feedback: 同类失败已经达到上限，循环应暂停并把证据交给用户，而不是继续扩大改动。

options.label: 让 AI 把任务标为完成，因为它已经尝试过两次
options.feedback: 尝试次数不是完成证据；构建和手机页面检查还没有通过。

options.label: 继续自动修改，直到检查通过为止，不再限制次数
options.feedback: 这会绕过已经设定的上限，并可能让改动范围不断扩大。

en.title: An agent tries to fix mobile navigation, but the same horizontal-overflow check fails twice. The rule allows two attempts for the same failure. What should happen next?

options.label: Pause, preserve both check results, and ask before expanding the change scope
options.feedback: The repeated failure has reached its limit, so the loop should pause and present evidence instead of expanding changes.

options.label: Mark the task complete because the agent already tried twice
options.feedback: Attempt count is not proof; the build and mobile-page check have not passed.

options.label: Keep editing automatically until the check passes, with no further limit
options.feedback: This bypasses the stated limit and can let the change scope keep growing.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请修复手机导航的横向滚动。每次修改后运行构建并检查 390px 页面；同类失败最多两次，需要改共享导航样式时先暂停确认。两项检查都通过才结束，并告诉我每轮为什么继续、暂停或完成。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Fix the mobile navigation overflow. After each change, run the build and inspect the page at 390px. Allow at most two attempts for the same failure and pause before changing shared navigation styles. Finish only when both checks pass, and report why each round continued, paused, or completed.

references.title: 可信 Agent 如何规划、行动、观察并继续

learning.assumes: You have seen an AI assistant read, edit, and check work in steps.
learning.outcome: You can name the conditions an agent loop controls and distinguish it from ReAct.

modules.title: When does a mobile navigation fix continue, pause, or stop?
How the application decides whether to run another round

items.title: Continue after an initial failure
items.text: If the failure is new and attempts remain, the application passes the check result into another round.

items.title: Pause at a limit or approval boundary
items.text: Two identical failures or a proposed shared-style change pauses the loop with its evidence.

items.title: Stop after real checks pass
items.text: The task ends only when the build passes and the 390px page no longer overflows.

modules.title: What people often confuse
modules.text: ReAct explains how new evidence changes the next action. An agent loop controls whether the application runs another round, including attempt, permission, pause, and stop conditions.
